items.source: Creates a new AuditableBeanWrapper using the given PersistentEntities when looking up auditing metadata via reflection.
items.translation: 使用给定的 PersistentEntities 创建一个新的 AuditableBeanWrapper，以便通过反射查找审计元数据。

items.source: Sets the DateTimeProvider to be used to determine the dates to be set.
items.translation: 设置用于确定要设置的日期的DateTimeProvider。

items.source: Returns whether the given source is considered to be auditable in the first place.
items.translation: 返回给定的源是否可审计。

items.source: Setter do determine if Auditable.setCreatedDate(TemporalAccessor)} and Auditable.setLastModifiedDate(TemporalAccessor) shall be filled with the current Java time.
items.translation: Setter 用于确定是否应使用当前 Java 时间填充 Auditable.setCreatedDate(TemporalAccessor)} 和 Auditable.setLastModifiedDate(TemporalAccessor)。

items.source: Setter do determine if Auditable.setCreatedDate(TemporalAccessor)} and Auditable.setLastModifiedDate(TemporalAccessor) shall be filled with the current Java time. Defaults to true. One might set this to false to use database features to set entity time.
items.translation: Setter 用于确定是否应将 Auditable.setCreatedDate(TemporalAccessor) 和 Auditable.setLastModifiedDate(TemporalAccessor) 填充为当前 Java 时间。默认值为 true。可以将此值设置为 false，以便使用数据库功能来设置实体时间。

items.source: Support class to implement auditing handlers.
items.translation: 支持类，用于实现审计处理器。

items.source:
Set this to true if you want to treat entity creation as modification and thus setting the current date as
modification date during creation, too.
items.translation: 将此值设置为 true，如果您希望将实体创建视为修改，从而在创建时也将当前日期设为修改日期。

items.source:
Set this to true if you want to treat entity creation as modification and thus setting the current date as
modification date during creation, too. Defaults to true.
items.translation: 将此值设置为 true 可将实体创建视为修改，从而在创建时也将当前日期设为修改日期。默认值为 true。

items.source: dateTimeProvider - can be null, defaults to CurrentDateTimeProvider in that case.
items.translation: dateTimeProvider - 可为 null，若为 null 则默认为CurrentDateTimeProvider。

items.source: modifyOnCreation - if modification information shall be set on creation, too
items.translation: modifyOnCreation - 如果在创建时也需设置修改信息，则设为 true。

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Christoph Strobl, Mark Paluch
items.translation: 奥利弗·吉尔克，克里斯托夫·施特罗布，马克·帕卢赫

items.source: true if the given source considered to be auditable.
items.translation: 如果给定的源被视为可审计，则为 true。
